items.heading: Table Stakes Are Skills
items.text: Table stakes are skills you need just to be considered. Differentiators decide between two candidates who both pass the first screen. This split is our reading of live postings and fresher guides, not an official list, so check postings for your own target.

items.heading: For Each Skill, Learn Enough
items.text: For each skill, learn enough to start, then know what a differentiator looks like.

items.heading: Tools Can Be Learned Faster
items.text: Tools can be learned faster than a sector. Understanding a sector takes longer, which is why it is the best multiplier for many analysts.
